reviews.text: We had a 121 session with today and learned more in 1 session than we have in 2 years of training. Andy is very knowledgeable and friendly and we now have the correct information to go away and put into practice ourselves. Would definitely recommend contacting Andy if you are struggling with your dog.

I've just been to see Andy for a recall training session with my dog, and it was absolutely amazing. Learning how to work with my dog in a positive way to achieve the best results has left me feeling so happy and confident.

Andy was super friendly, professional, and easy to talk to. He took the time to discuss various aspects of training and made everything clear and enjoyable. The training ground is excellent and provides a great environment for learning.

I would definitely recommend Andy to anyone looking to train their dog. A fantastic experience from start to finish!
